This report fits every Study 1 duration model reported in the main text and
the Supplemental Materials, and ends with a table of each reported number and
the model it comes from (Section 11). 

All models are Gaussian models of log-transformed duration, fitted with brms.
Group means are posterior geometric means, back-transformed to seconds and
averaged over the levels of any semantic covariate (emmeans). Intervals are
89% credible intervals.


# Priors

Intercept Normal(0, 1), placing 95% of the prior mass on geometric means
between about 0.14 s and 7.4 s; group contrasts Normal(0, 0.5), allowing
differences of up to about 2.7 times; random-effect and residual standard
deviations Exponential(1).

```{r priors}
std_priors <- c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))

# Robustness checks (Section 9)
wide_priors <- c(prior(normal(0, 2), class = Intercept),
                 prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                 prior(exponential(0.5), class = sd),
                 prior(exponential(0.5), class = sigma))
narrow_sd_priors <- c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                      prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                      prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                      prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
gamma_priors <- c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                  prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                  prior(exponential(1), class = shape))

ADAPT <- 0.95
fit <- function(name, formula, data, prior = std_priors, family = gaussian())
  fit_or_load(name, formula, data, prior, family, adapt_delta = ADAPT)
```

```{r summary-functions}
group_draws <- function(m) {
  emmeans(m, ~ language_group) %>% gather_emmeans_draws() %>% ungroup() %>%
    select(.draw, language_group, .value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = language_group, values_from = .value)
}

group_means <- function(m) {
  emmeans(m, ~ language_group) %>% gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
    group_by(language_group) %>%
    summarise(mean_s = mean(exp(.value)),
              lower = exp(quantile(.value, LO)), upper = exp(quantile(.value, HI)),
              .groups = "drop")
}

# Contrasts in the direction used in Table S3. P is the probability that
# English-learners' points are longer (first two rows) and that ASL-learners'
# points are shorter than homesigners' (third row).
group_contrasts <- function(m) {
  d <- group_draws(m)
  out <- bind_rows(summ(d$`English-Points` - d$ASL, "English - ASL"),
                   summ(d$`English-Points` - d$Homesign, "English - homesign"),
                   summ(d$ASL - d$Homesign, "ASL - homesign"))
  out$P <- c(out$p_positive[1:2], 1 - out$p_positive[3])
  select(out, term, estimate, lower, upper, P)
}

report <- function(m, caption) {
  print(kable(group_means(m), digits = 2, caption = paste(caption, "- geometric mean duration (s)")))
  print(kable(group_contrasts(m), digits = 3, caption = paste(caption, "- contrasts (log-seconds)")))
}
```

# Data

```{r data}
all_points %>%
  group_by(language_group) %>%
  summarise(points = n(), children = n_distinct(subject),
            mean_s = mean(duration_sec), sd_s = sd(duration_sec), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Points with a measured duration")

data.frame(scale = c("seconds", "log-seconds"),
           skewness = c(skewness(all_points$duration_sec), skewness(all_points$log_duration))) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Skewness of duration: the log scale removes most of the right skew")
```

# All points

```{r prior-predictive, fig.height = 3.5}
prior_check <- brm(log_duration ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
                   data = all_points, prior = std_priors, family = gaussian(),
                   sample_prior = "only", chains = 2, iter = 1000, warmup = 500,
                   seed = SEED, silent = 2, refresh = 0)
round(quantile(exp(posterior_predict(prior_check, ndraws = 500)), c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), 2)
round(quantile(all_points$duration_sec, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), 2)
```

The prior predictive distribution (first line, seconds) is wider than the
observed durations (second line) and places little mass on implausible values.

```{r all-points, fig.height = 3.5}
m_all <- fit("dur_all_full",
             log_duration ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric), all_points)
kable(convergence(m_all, "All points"), digits = 3)
pp_check(m_all, ndraws = 100) + labs(x = "log duration") + theme_minimal()
report(m_all, "All points")
```

## Semantic controls

Each model adds one semantic covariate: the nine semantic roles, entity versus
other roles, or action versus static roles.

```{r all-points-semantic}
m_all_roles  <- fit("sem_all_full_cat_full",
                    log_duration ~ language_group + semantic_cat + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
                    sem_all)
m_all_entity <- fit("sem_all_entoth_full",
                    log_duration ~ language_group + entity_vs_other + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
                    binary_subset(sem_all, "entity_vs_other"))
m_all_action <- fit("sem_all_acstat_full",
                    log_duration ~ language_group + action_vs_static + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
                    binary_subset(sem_all, "action_vs_static"))
report(m_all_roles,  "All points + all roles")
report(m_all_entity, "All points + entity vs. other")
report(m_all_action, "All points + action vs. static")
```

# Points produced alone

```{r isolated, fig.height = 3.5}
m_iso <- fit("foc_full_age",
             log_duration ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric), isolated_points)
kable(convergence(m_iso, "Isolated points"), digits = 3)
pp_check(m_iso, ndraws = 100) + labs(x = "log duration") + theme_minimal()
report(m_iso, "Isolated points")

# Region of practical equivalence for the ASL - homesign contrast: proportion
# of all posterior draws within +/-0.10 and +/-0.20 log-units.
asl_hs_iso <- with(group_draws(m_iso), ASL - Homesign)
c(within_0.10 = mean(abs(asl_hs_iso) < 0.10), within_0.20 = mean(abs(asl_hs_iso) < 0.20))

# Standard deviation of the age random intercept
summ(as_draws_df(m_iso)$sd_age_numeric__Intercept, "SD of age intercept")
```

# Isolation by group

All points with a coded context, with group, isolation and their interaction
as fixed effects (Table S4).

```{r iso-by-group}
m_ixg <- fit("dur_iso_main_interaction",
             log_duration ~ language_group * isolated + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
             iso_by_group_points)
kable(convergence(m_ixg, "Isolation by group"), digits = 3)

emmeans(m_ixg, ~ language_group * isolated) %>% gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  group_by(language_group, isolated) %>%
  summarise(mean_s = mean(exp(.value)),
            lower = exp(quantile(.value, LO)), upper = exp(quantile(.value, HI)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Table S4A: geometric mean duration (s) by group and context")

d <- as_draws_df(m_ixg)
eng <- d$b_isolatedIsolated
asl <- eng + d$`b_language_groupASL:isolatedIsolated`
hs  <- eng + d$`b_language_groupHomesign:isolatedIsolated`
bind_rows(summ(eng, "Alone - with other acts, English-learners"),
          summ(asl, "Alone - with other acts, ASL-learners"),
          summ(hs,  "Alone - with other acts, homesigners"),
          summ(asl - eng, "ASL-learners vs. English-learners"),
          summ(hs - eng,  "Homesigners vs. English-learners"),
          summ(asl - hs,  "ASL-learners vs. homesigners")) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Table S4B: lengthening in isolation (log-seconds)")
```

# Robustness of the all-points model

```{r robustness}
m_all_wide <- fit("dur_all_full_wide_priors",
                  log_duration ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
                  all_points, prior = wide_priors)
m_all_sd2  <- fit("dur_all_full_narrow_sd",
                  log_duration ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
                  all_points, prior = narrow_sd_priors)

p <- function(m) { d <- group_draws(m)
  c(`English - ASL` = mean(d$`English-Points` > d$ASL),
    `English - homesign` = mean(d$`English-Points` > d$Homesign),
    `ASL - homesign` = mean(d$ASL > d$Homesign)) }
shift <- rbind(primary = p(m_all), wider_priors = p(m_all_wide), sd_exponential_2 = p(m_all_sd2))
kable(shift, digits = 4, caption = "P(contrast > 0) under each prior")
c(max_shift_wider_priors = max(abs(shift[2, ] - shift[1, ])),
  max_shift_exponential_2 = max(abs(shift[3, ] - shift[1, ])))
```

The Gamma model is fitted to duration in seconds. To compare it with the
log-normal model, the log-normal model's pointwise log-likelihood is moved to
the seconds scale with the Jacobian of the log transform,
log p(y) = log p(log y) - log y (Vehtari, Gelman & Gabry, 2017).

```{r gamma}
m_gamma <- fit("dur_all_gamma",
               duration_sec ~ language_group + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric),
               all_points, prior = gamma_priors, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
loo_lognormal <- loo(sweep(log_lik(m_all), 2, all_points$log_duration, "-"))
loo_gamma     <- loo(log_lik(m_gamma))
loo_compare(list(lognormal = loo_lognormal, gamma = loo_gamma))
```

# Figure S4: duration by string length

Points produced alone are summarized from the isolated-point model with the
nine semantic roles; points in strings of two or more elements from a model
of points produced with other acts with group, string length and their
interaction, and the nine semantic roles. Values are posterior means and
standard deviations (in seconds) of the geometric mean.

```{r figure-s4, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4.2}
m_len <- fit("dur_bin",
             log_duration ~ group + semantic_cat + (1 | subject) + (1 | age_numeric) +
               len_bin + group:len_bin,
             by_length)

length_labels <- c(L2 = "2", L3 = "3", L4 = "4", L5 = "5+")
by_len <- emmeans(m_len, ~ group | len_bin) %>% gather_emmeans_draws() %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(group != "English") %>%
  transmute(group = as.character(group), length = unname(length_labels[as.character(len_bin)]), .value)
alone <- emmeans(m_iso_roles, ~ language_group) %>% gather_emmeans_draws() %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(language_group != "English-Points") %>%
  transmute(group = as.character(language_group), length = "Alone", .value)

counts <- bind_rows(
  sem_isolated %>% filter(language_group != "English-Points") %>%
    transmute(group = as.character(language_group), length = "Alone"),
  by_length %>% filter(group != "English") %>%
    transmute(group = as.character(group), length = unname(length_labels[as.character(len_bin)]))) %>%
  count(group, length)

fig_s4 <- bind_rows(alone, by_len) %>%
  group_by(group, length) %>%
  summarise(mean_s = mean(exp(.value)), se_s = sd(exp(.value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(counts, by = c("group", "length")) %>%
  mutate(length = factor(length, levels = c("Alone", "2", "3", "4", "5+"))) %>%
  arrange(length, group)
kable(fig_s4, digits = 3)

ggplot(fig_s4, aes(length, mean_s, colour = group, shape = group, group = group)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.12), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_s - se_s, ymax = mean_s + se_s),
                position = position_dodge(0.12), width = 0.15) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.12), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(ASL = "#00BA38", Homesign = "#619CFF"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(ASL = 16, Homesign = 17), name = NULL) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Elements in the string", y = "Point duration (s), model estimate ± 1 SE") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

# Convergence (Table S9)

```{r convergence}
reported <- list(
  "All points" = m_all,
  "All points + all roles" = m_all_roles,
  "All points + entity vs. other" = m_all_entity,
  "All points + action vs. static" = m_all_action,
  "Isolated points" = m_iso,
  "Isolated + all roles" = m_iso_roles,
  "Isolated + entity vs. other" = m_iso_entity,
  "Isolated + action vs. static" = m_iso_action,
  "With other acts + all roles" = m_with_roles,
  "With other acts + entity vs. other" = m_with_entity,
  "With other acts + action vs. static" = m_with_action,
  "Isolated points, no age intercept" = m_iso_noage,
  "Isolated + all roles, no age intercept" = m_iso_roles_noage,
  "Isolated + entity vs. other, no age intercept" = m_iso_entity_noage,
  "Isolated + action vs. static, no age intercept" = m_iso_action_noage,
  "Isolation by group" = m_ixg,
  "All points, wider priors" = m_all_wide,
  "All points, random-effect SDs Exponential(2)" = m_all_sd2,
  "All points, Gamma likelihood" = m_gamma,
  "Duration by string length (Figure S4)" = m_len)
conv <- bind_rows(Map(convergence, reported, names(reported)))
kable(conv, digits = c(0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Numbers reported in the manuscript

```{r manuscript-numbers}
ci <- function(r, sign = 1) {
  e <- sign * r$estimate; b <- sort(sign * c(r$lower, r$upper))
  sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", e, b[1], b[2])
}
gm <- function(m) { g <- group_means(m)
  paste(sprintf("%s %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", c("English", "ASL", "homesign"),
                g$mean_s, g$lower, g$upper), collapse = "; ") }
p_range <- function(models, row) {
  v <- sapply(models, function(m) group_contrasts(m)$P[row])
  sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", min(v), max(v))
}
c_all <- group_contrasts(m_all); c_iso <- group_contrasts(m_iso)
sem_all_models <- list(m_all_roles, m_all_entity, m_all_action)
sem_iso_models <- list(m_iso_roles, m_iso_entity, m_iso_action)
excludes_zero <- function(models, row) all(sapply(models, function(m) {
  r <- group_contrasts(m)[row, ]; r$lower > 0 | r$upper < 0 }))

data.frame(
  result = c(
    "All points: convergence (max R-hat; min fixed-effect bulk ESS; divergences)",
    "All points: ASL - English, beta [89% CrI]; P(English > ASL)",
    "All points: homesign - English; P(English > homesign)",
    "All points: ASL - homesign; P(ASL < homesign)",
    "All points: geometric means (s)",
    "Semantic controls, all points: P(English > ASL)",
    "Semantic controls, all points: P(ASL < homesign); intervals exclude 0 in all three",
    "Semantic controls, all points: P(English > homesign); intervals exclude 0 in any",
    "Isolated points: N, children",
    "Isolated points: convergence",
    "Isolated: ASL - English; P(English > ASL)",
    "Isolated: homesign - English; P(English > homesign)",
    "Isolated: ASL - homesign; P(ASL < homesign)",
    "Isolated: ASL - homesign, posterior within +/-0.20",
    "Isolated: geometric means (s)",
    "Semantic controls, isolated: P(English > ASL)",
    "Semantic controls, isolated: P(English > homesign)",
    "Semantic controls, isolated: P(ASL < homesign)",
    "Wider priors: largest change in P",
    "Exponential(2) SD prior: largest change in P",
    "Log-normal vs. Gamma: ELPD difference (SE)"),
  value = c(
    with(convergence(m_all, ""), sprintf("%.3f; %.0f; %d", max_rhat, bulk_ess_fixed, divergences)),
    sprintf("%s; %.3f", ci(c_all[1, ], -1), c_all$P[1]),
    sprintf("%s; %.3f", ci(c_all[2, ], -1), c_all$P[2]),
    sprintf("%s; %.3f", ci(c_all[3, ]), c_all$P[3]),
    gm(m_all),
    p_range(sem_all_models, 1),
    sprintf("%s; %s", p_range(sem_all_models, 3), excludes_zero(sem_all_models, 3)),
    sprintf("%s; %s", p_range(sem_all_models, 2),
            any(sapply(sem_all_models, function(m) { r <- group_contrasts(m)[2, ]; r$lower > 0 | r$upper < 0 }))),
    sprintf("%d, %d", nobs(m_iso), n_distinct(isolated_points$subject)),
    with(convergence(m_iso, ""), sprintf("%.3f; %.0f; %d", max_rhat, bulk_ess_fixed, divergences)),
    sprintf("%s; %.3f", ci(c_iso[1, ], -1), c_iso$P[1]),
    sprintf("%s; %.3f", ci(c_iso[2, ], -1), c_iso$P[2]),
    sprintf("%s; %.3f", ci(c_iso[3, ]), c_iso$P[3]),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(abs(asl_hs_iso) < 0.20)),
    gm(m_iso),
    p_range(sem_iso_models, 1),
    p_range(sem_iso_models, 2),
    p_range(sem_iso_models, 3),
    sprintf("%.4f", max(abs(shift[2, ] - shift[1, ]))),
    sprintf("%.4f", max(abs(shift[3, ] - shift[1, ]))),
    with(as.data.frame(loo_compare(list(lognormal = loo_lognormal, gamma = loo_gamma))),
         sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", elpd_diff[2], se_diff[2])))) %>%
  kable()
```
